The '''Destruction of N'zoth''' was a battle that occurred during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], the conflict was a result of intelligence passed to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by the [[Fian/Legends|Fia]] of [[Galantos]], who feared the nearby [[Yevetha]]'s new battle [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="FH1" />

==The battle==
In 28 ABY, the Yuuzhan Vong invasion was in its fourth year. The [[Galantos Guard]] came across the Yuuzhan Vong and, informing them of the threat posed by the proximal and potentially resurgent Yevetha&mdash;a deadly species who had been [[Black Fleet Crisis|defeated years earlier]]&mdash;and their new fleet of [[Aramadia-class thrustship|''Aramadia''-class thrustships]], appealed to them for protection from the Yevetha. The Yuuzhan Vong agreed to this, and invaded the Yevethan homeworld of N'zoth. Despite the Yevetha possessing a formidable fleet of several thousand thrustships, dozens of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital vessels]] and a large [[battle station]], the Yuuzhan Vong entered the fray with vastly superior numbers, and routed the Yevethan forces.<ref name="FH1" />

With the orbital component of the battle thus completed, the Yuuzhan Vong pounded N'zoth from orbit, reducing its surface to a cratered mess. Every piece of the Yevethan civilization was utterly expunged.<ref name="FH1" /> The Yuuzhan Vong persisted in hunting down the remaining Yevetha throughout the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], leaving seven thousand Yevetha still living by the end of the war.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

===Aftermath===
Upon learning of the Yevethan threat from the Fia, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and two Chiss pilots, [[Miza]] and [[Jocell]], traveled to N'zoth to scout out the Yevethan activity in the system, unaware of the carnage wrought by the Yuuzhan Vong. They discovered the remains of the fleet and a devastated N'zoth. A Yevethan survivor was thereafter encountered; this individual detonated his thrustship and killed Miza in the process.<ref name="FH1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of N'zoth, or, rather, its aftermath, appears in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'' by [[Sean Williams]] and [[Shane Dix]], released in [[2003]].<ref name="FH1" />
